# About us

The **BiostatOmics** group was established in January 2024 at the
[Department of Applied Statistics, Operations Research and Quality](https://www.upv.es/entidades/DEIO/),
[Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV)](https://www.upv.es/) (Spain), and is led by [Dr. Sonia Tarazona](people/tarazona-sonia/index.qmd).

We are a research group at the interface of **statistics**, **machine learning** and **computational biology**.

Our work focuses on developing novel [statistical methods and open-source software](tools/index.qmd) for the analysis of **omic** or **multi-omics (MO)** datasets (transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, epigenomics, and beyond) to understand complex biological systems.
